title: The scanner spec reads the app's own /scan headers on a protected preview and waits for the scanner's re-load, so pr-compare stops failing on Vercel's cookie redirect

source.ref: LIVE-213 cause (d), named in #3109 (pr-compare run 36678631457, e2e-manual smoke job 109734068949); ADR-1696

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1696), one of the three regressions LIVE-213's recapture (#3109) left on main. THE CONSEQUENCE: pr-compare, not a required check, failed on every PR on the LIVE-713 scanner spec, two ways. (1) THE HEADER TEST read `page.request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0 })` and found ZERO Permissions-Policy lines for /scan on every protected preview (run 36678631457: Received length 0, three attempts). playwright.config.ts sends `x-vercel-set-bypass-cookie: true` beside the bypass secret, so the first request can be Vercel's cookie-setting redirect back to the same URL: a platform hop that carries none of next.config.ts's headers (the likeliest reading of zero lines on the first path read and the one this fix targets; the spec now logs the status it measured, so the pr-compare run confirms or refutes it). /scan is the first path the test reads, so it always read the hop. (2) THE SOFT-NAVIGATION TEST waited the 5 s default from `router.push` for the scanning line. The push fetches /scan's RSC payload, mounts the scanner in the /settings document, and only then does the scanner re-load /scan as its own document: two cold round trips to a preview. Smoke job 109734068949 shows the race lost (navigated to /scan?hint=partner, then element(s) not found); #3109's run won it. THE FIX, test only: `appResponse` steps over a redirect whose Location is the SAME origin, path and query (at most three, then it throws), and returns any other response unfollowed, so a signed-out /scan sent to /sign-in by proxy.ts is still the response measured. The assertions are unchanged: one Permissions-Policy line, /scan camera=(self), / and /sign-in camera=(), microphone=() and geolocation=(self) on each. The spec logs, and the failure message names, the status read and any hop. The soft-navigation test starts waiting for the /scan DOCUMENT request (isNavigationRequest, main frame, not a 3xx) before the push, asserts it answered 2xx, and gives the scanning line and the video readyState 20 s; a scanner that never re-loads now fails at that wait by name. It still asserts a running viewfinder, no denied card, and a navigation entry at /scan. Nothing skipped or quarantined. No product code changed. Verified by pr-compare on this PR (see its body).

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const fail=(m)=>{console.error("LIVE-735: "+m);process.exit(1)};const F="test/e2e/scan-camera.spec.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(F))fail(F+" is gone");const raw=fs.readFileSync(F,"utf8");const S=raw.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,"").replace(/(^|[^:])\/\/.*$/gm,"$1");if(/\.(fixme|only)\(|test\.fail\(|test\.describe\.skip|test\.skip\(\s*true/.test(S))fail("the scanner spec skips, quarantines or narrows a test");const hi=S.indexOf("camera=(self) and other pages camera=()");const si=S.indexOf("test.describe(\x27signed in\x27");if(hi<0||si<hi)fail("the header test is gone or moved");const H=S.slice(hi,si);for(const p of ["\x27/scan\x27, \x27camera=(self)\x27","\x27/\x27, \x27camera=()\x27","\x27/sign-in\x27, \x27camera=()\x27"])if(!H.includes(p))fail("the header test no longer checks "+p);if(!/toHaveLength\(1\)/.test(H)||!/toContain\(camera\)/.test(H)||!/toContain\(\x27microphone=\(\)\x27\)/.test(H))fail("the header test no longer asserts one Permissions-Policy line carrying the route camera directive");if(/request\.get\(path,\s*\{\s*maxRedirects:\s*0\s*\}\)/.test(H))fail("the header test still reads the first response at maxRedirects 0, which on a protected preview is the Vercel cookie redirect with no app headers");const m=S.match(/async function (\w+)\(request[^)]*\)\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\n\}/);if(!m||!H.includes(m[1]+"("))fail("no helper reads the app response for the header test");const B=m[2];if(!/maxRedirects:\s*0/.test(B))fail("the helper follows redirects, so a signed-out /scan redirect would no longer be the response measured");if(!/pathname\s*===\s*target\.pathname/.test(B)||!/search\s*===\s*target\.search/.test(B)||!/origin\s*===\s*target\.origin/.test(B))fail("the helper steps over redirects other than a same-URL hop");if(!/for\s*\(let i = 0; i < \d/.test(B))fail("the helper has no bound on same-URL hops");const ti=S.indexOf("reached by a soft navigation");if(ti<0)fail("the soft-navigation test is gone");const T=S.slice(ti);const push=T.indexOf("router.push(");const wait=T.search(/waitForResponse\(/);if(wait<0||push<0||wait>push)fail("the soft-navigation test does not start waiting for the scanner re-load before the push");if(!/isNavigationRequest\(\)/.test(T)||!/pathname === \x27\/scan\x27/.test(T))fail("the soft-navigation wait is not for the /scan document request");if(!/toBeGreaterThanOrEqual\(2\)/.test(T)||!/toHaveCount\(0\)/.test(T)||!/toBe\(\x27\/scan\x27\)/.test(T))fail("the soft-navigation test no longer asserts a running viewfinder in a document loaded at /scan");console.log("LIVE-735: the /scan header test reads the app response past the Vercel same-URL cookie hop, and the soft-navigation test waits for the scanner re-load")'
